Connect automatically when this keypad is attached
Physical keys and LCD updates stay active. Tap to return to MX Pocket.
Tap to open the app selected on your keypad.
If the app did not open, tap to try again.

On an unlocked phone, a key on the Phone page can open another app without a notification tap. Android requires “Display over other apps”, a broad permission that also allows drawing over other apps. MX Pocket does not draw overlays. Turn this option off anytime, or revoke access in Android settings. Leave it off to use notifications instead.
Unlock the phone and press the keypad shortcut again.
Shortcut no longer available. Press the key on the connected keypad again.
Choose custom image for all nine keys
Not connected. USB permission and a compatible HID descriptor are required.
Phone-only preview. No USB messages are sent and no hardware is being tested.
Source-supported profile: one 480x480 panel, nine 118x118 visible key regions. Physical behavior has not been verified on this phone.
Accessibility control is enabled. Clip Studio page keys drive Clip Studio Paint.
Enable the MX Pocket service in Android accessibility settings to let the Clip Studio page drive Clip Studio Paint.

Lets the MX Pocket Clip Studio keypad page drive Clip Studio Paint (tool selection and tool settings) by tapping its on-screen controls. Only Clip Studio Paint windows are observed. Enable or disable this service in Android accessibility settings.
